title: Data governance intake: onboarding checklist, SLA & routing matrix for control requests
creator: Avery Chen
description: Goal: Create a pragmatic, enforceable intake and triage artifact that product, sales, and support use to onboard and prioritize enterprise requests for data-governance controls (logging redaction, retention windows, PII handling, audit export formats). This ticket will define the intake form, a 3-tier classification rubric (Low/Medium/High impact), an SLA and routing matrix (who owns initial triage, expected response windows, decision owners), and a minimal automation plan for routing into Linear/Github/Support. Deliverable will be a published Playbook page, a templated Intake Form (internal and customer-facing variant), and one automation prototype to route new requests to the right owner queue.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form fields finalized and mockups available (internal + customer-facing).
Classification rubric with examples for Logging Redaction, Retention, PII, and Audit Exports documented.
SLA matrix published: initial ack (24h/8h/2h), triage decision (5d/3d/48h) mapped by severity and customer tier.
Routing matrix that maps classification to owning team (Product, Eng Infra, Security, Legal, Support) completed.
Automation prototype (Zapier/Workato or internal webhook) that creates Linear ticket with pre-filled labels and assignee for Medium/High routed requests demoed.
Stakeholder signoff from Legal and Security recorded in comments.
Playbook page published in Confluence and linked from support intake channels.
Metrics to track introduced: time-to-ack, time-to-triage-decision, percent auto-routed; baseline measurements captured.
comments: 2025-11-12 Avery Chen: Initial draft of objectives and scope. Focus on non-bug enterprise requests: redaction, retention, PII handling, and audit exports. Proposing 3 impact tiers and separate internal vs external intake forms.

2025-11-13 Diego Martinez: Reviewed technical routing constraints. Suggested adding an 'requires infra config' boolean to intake and mapping that to ENG-Infra queue. Will estimate automation effort after design finalization.

2025-11-14 Priya Kapoor (Legal): Requested that classification include regulatory triggers (GDPR data subject requests, SOC2 evidence export). Legal approval required before publishing external-facing intake.
2025-11-15 Morgan Lee (DX/Support): Provided mockup for customer-facing intake: simpler language, optional attachments for exported schemas. Asked to keep SLAs visible in UI for enterprise customers.

2025-11-16 Diego Martinez: POC webhook script created, demo scheduled 2025-11-18. Draft mapping: Low -> Support, Medium -> Product Manager + ENG Infra, High -> Security + Legal + Eng Infra. Added ENG-3410 as dependency for infra ownership.
2025-11-18 Legal signoff: Priya Kapoor: Provided comments on audit export retention window wording; required an explicit consent checkbox and KMS key disclosure for Private deployments.

2025-11-19 Elena Rossi (Customer Success): Suggested SLA differentiation by contract tier; enterprise customers with Dedicated or Private should have faster decision SLAs and a 'technical callback' option.
2025-11-20 Avery Chen: Updated rubrics and SLA matrix per feedback; moving ticket to In Progress for automation sprint next week. Linking to Confluence draft and automation PR.
decision_log: 2025-11-13: Decided on three impact tiers (Low/Medium/High) to balance operational effort and legal risk.
2025-11-16: Decided automation will pre-populate Linear tickets and apply labels: data-governance, retention, redaction, pii, audit-export. Medium+High get auto-assigned to on-call rotations.
2025-11-18: Legal required explicit consent language for external intake; added required field to external form and added 'legal_escalation' label for High.
2025-11-19: SLA differential approved: Enterprise Dedicated/Private customers move to 'Priority' track (2h ack for High).
implementation_notes: Keep intake minimal for customers: required: request type, example data types, retention change requested, redaction scope, legal/regulatory flags, contract tier. Internal intake includes risk assessment fields and suggested remediation timeline. Automation will only create Medium/High tickets initially to reduce noise.
outstanding_risks: Legal changes in retention policy may require retroactive changes; automation must include manual override. Some private/on-prem customers will have strict KMS/airgapped constraints; need Security signoff per customer.
